reviews.rights: New conceptual illustration generated at the repository owner's request and explicitly approved by the owner. Native cue symbols and annotations were newly authored. Source paper figures informed the concept; publisher PDF and original figure images are excluded.
reviews.privacy: Actual image visually inspected at full and README display sizes. Fictional illustrated person, no participant portrait, identities or study records. PNG metadata inspected: generic Ghostscript Software tag and grayscale ICC profile; no EXIF, identifying paths or private study information.

reviews.rights: New conceptual illustration generated with the host image tool or newly authored TikZ annotations. Owner requested preserving the generation workflow and outputs in this repository. Publisher PDF and reference figure images are excluded; no separate licence for publisher content is asserted.
reviews.privacy: Actual artwork visually inspected: conceptual person and schematic objects/screens, no participant portrait or study records. Available metadata and bytes checked for identifying machine paths; original tool outputs retain generated-content credentials.
